name: HYDRA-UMC-OS-REBUILDER
build: Builds a ready-to-flash Raspberry Pi OS image for the CM5, pre-loaded with the most current version of every ecosystem project it can reach on GitHub, and lets the operator set first-boot Wi-Fi/user/hostname/SSH configuration before writing the image - the same customization Raspberry Pi Imager itself offers, one step earlier.
notes: Its own real test suite (`pytest tests`) passes in full: 130 tests passed. The real remote-build path (SSH to a Linux host, chroot, profile-build reproducibility) has already been exercised and fixed for real against the CM5's own ecosystem checkout. Windows/Linux desktop tool, CLI and Qt Quick GUI (reusing HYDRA-UMC-UPDATER's own visual language). Depends on hydra-umc-updater as a library for ecosystem discovery/version-checking rather than duplicating that logic. The image-build pipeline (loop-mount, chroot) is Linux-only and reports that honestly on Windows instead of pretending to run.
